title: Derived square for termwise finite free pullback
statement: Let T, X, Z, f, W, A, B, α, eA and eB be a specified bounded-above finite-free chart model as in the following sense: X,Z are derived objects [def-pc-derived-category] on a scheme T [def-pc-scheme]; A,B are bounded-above cochain complexes [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules] on W with finite free terms [def-weil-pbc-free-module]; eA:L(W.ι)*X≅Q(A) and eB:L(W.ι)*Z≅Q(B) identify L(W.ι)*(f) with Q(α) [def-pc-derived-pullback], but without choosing a cohomological degree. For g:T′→T put V=g⁻¹(W), and F=tensorPullback(g|_V) followed by the inverse module-site equivalence [def-pc-module-pullback]. Given additivity of F, put P=F(A), Q=F(B), β=F(α). Let R be exact restriction to the localized site over V. In its standard derived category there exist isomorphisms dP:Rᴰ(Lg*X)≅Q(P), dQ:Rᴰ(Lg*Z)≅Q(Q), satisfying Rᴰ(Lg*f)≫dQ.hom=dP.hom≫Q(β). This statement asserts the geometric comparison before applying any homology functor.

source.place: K-flat computation 06YJ, bounded-above flatness 06YD, and composition 0D5S along the cartesian open square

proof.text: Set V=g inverse-image W and h=g.resLE W V (le_refl V). Define F explicitly as tensorPullback h followed by (Modules.overEquiv V).inverse. The tensor-pullback adjunction makes it right exact and hence additive; the equivalence is additive, so F is additive. Finite free terms are finite sums of the structure sheaf, hence flat. The bounded-above flat complexes A and B are K-flat. Use one left-derived counit ε for tensorPullback h; its components at A and B are invertible. If flatComplexDerivedPullback presents another counit, the unique isomorphism of left-derived functors transports its invertibility to ε. Naturality at α gives the termwise square.

Along the cartesian open square, compose the natural derived composition isomorphisms to identify L(V.ι)* Lg* with Lh* L(W.ι)*. Open immersion pullback is exact restriction, so its left-derived universal property identifies it with restriction.mapDerivedCategory. Map the given chart square through Lh*, then compose with the single counit at A and B. Finally transport through the exact inverse module-site equivalence and its mapDerivedCategoryFactors. This gives the derived square in the localized-site derived category, before applying homology.

theorem bottomFreeChain_derived_square
    [∀ Y : Scheme.{u}, HasDerivedCategory.{w}
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    (T : Scheme.{u}) (X Z : schemeDerivedCategory T) (f : X ⟶ Z)
    (W : T.Opens)
    (A B : CochainComplex
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings W.toScheme.toRingedSpace)) ℤ)
    (hAbounded : ∃ c : ℤ, ∀ i : ℤ, c < i → IsZero (A.X i))
    (hBbounded : ∃ c : ℤ, ∀ i : ℤ, c < i → IsZero (B.X i))
    (hAfree : ∀ i : ℤ, ∃ n : ℕ, Nonempty (A.X i ≅ SheafOfModules.free
      (R := moduleRings W.toScheme.toRingedSpace) (ULift.{u} (Fin n))))
    (hBfree : ∀ i : ℤ, ∃ n : ℕ, Nonempty (B.X i ≅ SheafOfModules.free
      (R := moduleRings W.toScheme.toRingedSpace) (ULift.{u} (Fin n))))
    (α : A ⟶ B)
    (eA : (derivedPullback W.ι).obj X ≅ DerivedCategory.Q.obj A)
    (eB : (derivedPullback W.ι).obj Z ≅ DerivedCategory.Q.obj B)
    (hsquare : (derivedPullback W.ι).map f ≫ eB.hom =
      eA.hom ≫ DerivedCategory.Q.map α)
    (T' : Scheme.{u}) (g : T' ⟶ T) :
    let V := g ⁻¹ᵁ W
    let F := Modules.tensorPullback (g.resLE W V (le_refl V)) ⋙
      (Modules.overEquiv V).inverse
    ∀ hF : F.Additive,
      letI := hF
      letI := HasDerivedCategory.standard
        (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings T'.toRingedSpace).over V))
      let R := SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{u} (moduleRings T'.toRingedSpace) V
      let P := (F.mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj A
      let Q := (F.mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj B
      let β := (F.mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).map α
      ∃ (eP : R.mapDerivedCategory.obj ((derivedPullback g).obj X) ≅
          DerivedCategory.Q.obj P)
        (eQ : R.mapDerivedCategory.obj ((derivedPullback g).obj Z) ≅
          DerivedCategory.Q.obj Q),
        R.mapDerivedCategory.map ((derivedPullback g).map f) ≫ eQ.hom =
          eP.hom ≫ DerivedCategory.Q.map β
